_comment: Server settings. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Anything left out uses the built-in default.
_password: Must match the password in the Pi's pi_config.json.

decider._comment: backend: dummy, python or http. See the top of hookup.py.
decider._dummy_throttle: dummy backend: 1.0 = all wheels at full configured speed as soon as the car connects.
decider._options: Passed to the python module's configure(options). Free-form; the module decides what it needs.

options._cnn_api_url: Temporary sign_decider only: the remote CNN API endpoint. Ask the CNN's owner; not kept in git.
